Schemes and prices

We are empanelled for CGHS, RGHS and ECHS, so covered treatment is cashless. For everyone else, our starting prices are below, so there are no surprises.

Check my coverage See prices

Which scheme do you have?

Bring the documents listed. Our front desk verifies your card before treatment and tells you what is covered.

CGHS

Empanelled
Central Government Health Scheme Who: Central government employees, pensioners and dependants Bring: CGHS card and wellness-centre referral Where: Both clinics

RGHS

Empanelled
Rajasthan Government Health Scheme Who: Rajasthan government employees, pensioners and dependants Bring: RGHS card and a photo ID Where: Both clinics

ECHS

Empanelled
Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme Who: Ex-servicemen and dependants Bring: ECHS card and polyclinic referral Where: Ramganj clinic

CAPF and Air India

Accepted
Other panels listed by the clinic Who: CAPF personnel, Air India staff and dependants Bring: Panel ID card and referral letter Where: Ramganj clinic

Paying at the clinic

Pay by cash, UPI or card at the front desk after your consultation. EMI is available for implants and larger treatment plans.

There is no charge to book an appointment.
